text: What payment methods do you support for paying my invoice?
demo_note: KB-grounded FAQ: classify, retrieve, draft, validate, cite, send. The full autonomous path, under four seconds.

text: I want a $750 refund for the outage last week. Please process it today.
demo_note: Safety is a veto, not a weighted average: the quality score alone clears the bar, and it still doesn't send.

text: This is the third time you have double charged me. Fix it or I am contacting my lawyer.
demo_note: A legal threat in the inbound message is a deterministic policy match, detected in the customer's own words, before any model runs.

text: Please cancel my subscription and delete my account data.
demo_note: Data-deletion requests route to the privacy team by policy, not by model judgment.

text: Our webhook integration is failing with HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout during peak hours. How do we raise the timeout?
demo_note: The knowledge base has no technical/API content. Retrieval correctly finds nothing, and the gate blocks the model from answering anyway rather than inventing an answer.

text: You charged my card 4111 2222 3333 4444 twice this month. Please explain.
demo_note: An ambiguous dispute the model reasonably asks the customer to clarify instead of citing policy for — correct behaviour, and a chance to show body_redacted stripping the card number before anything left the process.

text: We reduced our team last month and have 5 unused seats on our annual plan. Can we get a prorated refund?
demo_note: A grounded, correctly cited draft that still falls just short of the refund intent's higher bar (0.90) — the threshold is a real quality bar, not a rubber stamp.
